content: Addaame zereththi hayssafe kaallidi xaafettides; Xoossi as medhdhida gallas bana misatissidi medhdhides.
Addenne maccas ooththi medhdhidi istta anjjides. Istta medhdhidi as gi sunththides.
Addaamey 130 layth de7idi bana misatiza attuma naa yelidi iza, «Seete» gi sunththides.
Addaamey Seete yelidaappe guye 800 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Seetey Heenoose yelidaappe guye 807 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Heenoosey Qaynaane yelidaappe guye 815 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Qaynaaney Malal7eele yelidaappe guye 840 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Malal7eeley Yaareede yelidaappe guye 830 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Yaareedey Heenooke yelidaappe guye 800 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Maatusaala yelidaappe guye Heenookey 300 layth Xoossa ufayssishe de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Izi Xoossa ufayssishe diin Xoossi iza ekkida gishshas beettontta dhaydes.
Maatusaalay Laameeke yelidaappe guye, 782 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Laameekey 182 layth de7idi attuma naa yelidi,
«Ha naazi GODAY qanggida biitta bollan nuna nu daaburappe shempisana» giidi Nohe gi sunththides.
Laameekey Nohe yelidaappe guye 595 layth de7ides; hara attuma naytanne macca nayta yelides.
Nohey 500 layth de7idi Seeme, Kaamenne Yaafeete yelides.

footnotes.text: Nohe guussi Ibraaweta qaalara shempo guussa.
